clips.title: The story
paras: Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp needs to determine whether Yenniku, the son of the Darkspear chieftain, is dead. Adventurers are asked to hunt Bloodscalp headhunters and recover their shrunken heads so Nimboya can examine them.

Following the search begun in Hunt for Yenniku, Nimboya worries that the chieftain's son may have already perished at the hands of the Bloodscalp tribe. To find out, he asks you to hunt the Bloodscalp Headhunters roaming the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda up the northern coast. By gathering twenty shrunken heads from them, Nimboya hopes to inspect the grisly trophies and confirm whether Yenniku met a violent end, cursing the Bloodscalp chief Gan'zulah if the youth was indeed slain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must find if Yenniku is dead.
Slay the Bloodscalp Headhunters and take from them their Shrunken Heads. You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.
And if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!
Go, friend. You may find many Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda, along the coast to the north.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. I fear for our chief's son. Do you have the shrunken heads so I may inspect them?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I will inspect these heads to ensure poor Yenniku was spared the headhunter's axe.
